en: I could swear I left the keys here, but they're not here.
es: Juraría que dejé las llaves aquí, pero no están.
why: The keys are missing, so it's only a strong memory.

en: I know for a fact Rosa paid, I saw the receipt.
es: Me consta que Rosa pagó, yo vi el recibo.
why: Seeing the receipt makes it a verified fact.

en: I could swear Tomás said Thursday, but maybe it was Friday.
es: Juraría que Tomás dijo el jueves, pero tal vez fue el viernes.
why: Doubt follows, so it's a memory.

en: I can vouch that the money arrived, I was there when it came.
es: Me consta que llegó la plata, yo estaba ahí cuando llegó.

en: I'd swear I've seen that man before, but I don't know where.
es: Juraría que ya vi a ese señor, pero no sé dónde.
why: Not knowing where means it's a hunch.

en: I know for sure Don Hernando never missed a day, I checked the records.
es: Me consta que Don Hernando nunca faltó, revisé los registros.

en: I could swear it was raining when we left, but I can't be sure.
es: Juraría que llovía cuando salimos, pero no estoy seguro.

en: I can attest that Vale worked all night, I was with her.
es: Me consta que Vale trabajó toda la noche, yo estuve con ella.
why: Being with her makes it first hand.
